judge.rationale: The candidate's implementation in `chatOrchestrator.ts` is functionally identical to the reference, choosing the same design of renaming the `afterModelResponse` hook parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` and accumulating per-round `UsageMetadata` via a helper function (`addUsage` vs `accumulateUsage`). It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including explicitly testing a turn with two tool rounds (three provider calls), partial-reporting rounds, and completely unreported turns while leaving existing tests untouched. The candidate also updates all the same documentation and specification files (`CHANGELOG.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, and the three spec files) with accurate test line references. The only minor deviations from the reference are placing the new acceptance tests in a separate `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file (alongside `.lore/dod.md`) rather than solely in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and rewriting the bullet in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` in place under the `Measured semantics — out of scope` heading rather than moving it up into the main specification list.
